source: Palm tracker PLM-041 (25 Sept 2026), changed by PLM-139 and PLM-145 (13 Oct 2026): the general layout to scale is in all three packages; a Concept space is one room with a door; the Creative Director package is priced from its rate (a higher rate is approved by the Creative Director) and the Creative Director reviews its concepts and renders. Minimum design deposit from the Palm flow. Questions (12 Oct 2026): Palm's Core Client Discovery Questions (30 questions in 6 sections and the agreed next step) and its Joinery Technical Checklists rev 01 (14 checklists of 10 checks, each confirmed, pending or not applicable with its requirement or reference), plus the factory release and handover record as a checklist for every job.

packages.name: Concept Package
packages.inclusions: General layout to scale, a digital mood board and concepts, then samples. No renders.

packages.name: Bespoke Interior Design
packages.inclusions: General layout to scale, a digital mood board and concepts, 2D and 3D renders, then samples.

packages.name: Designed by the Creative Director
packages.inclusions: Led by the Creative Director, who chooses the lead designer and approves every concept and render. General layout to scale, 2D and 3D renders, then samples.

siteVisitQuestions.question: What type of property or space is this, and where is it located?
Which rooms or areas would you like us to work on?
Are you looking for interior design, furniture, fit out, or a combination?
Is the space new, occupied, or being renovated?
What would you most like to improve about the space?
Who will use the space, and how will they use it day to day?
Do you have children, pets, or any comfort or accessibility needs we should consider?
Do you regularly host guests, work from home, or need flexible spaces?
What works well in your current space, and what feels missing?
What are your top three priorities for this project?
How would you describe the look and atmosphere you want?
Do you have inspiration images or examples you can share?
Which colours, materials, or textures do you like or dislike?
Do you prefer a consistent look throughout or different styles for each room?
Are there any features or design choices you definitely want to avoid?
Which furniture pieces do you need for each room?
Which existing pieces would you like to keep, replace, or reuse?
Do you prefer ready made furniture, custom furniture, or a mix?
What matters most to you when choosing furniture: comfort, appearance, durability, or easy maintenance?
Would you like help with curtains, rugs, lighting, artwork, and accessories too?
What overall budget range would you be comfortable with?
Should that budget include design fees, furniture, fit out, delivery, and installation?
Which items would you invest more in, and where would you prefer to save?
When would you like to start, and when do you need the project completed?
Is the deadline linked to moving in, an event, or another commitment?
Who will be involved in making decisions and approving the proposals?
How would you prefer us to communicate and share updates?
Would you like us to manage the whole project, or are other teams already involved?
Would you prefer to complete everything together or in phases?
Is there anything else we should know before preparing the proposal?
